dimensions.name: past work
dimensions.evidence: Described KKday agent project: built agent design, core backend, Android SSE parsing; led 5-person team. Explained a specific bug (day order) with reproduction and fix, and a delivery risk with options and rollback plan. Clear ownership boundaries.

dimensions.name: current ability
dimensions.evidence: Designed mobile wallet MVP with clear client/server/local storage ownership. Sequence diagram for transfer with idempotency, pending row, status lookup, and four result states. Handled lost response, process kill, not-found, concurrent transfers, and session switching. Explained trade-offs (sorting vs. keying by day, waiting vs. streaming).

dimensions.name: handling unknowns
dimensions.evidence: Clarified requirements before design. Handled ambiguous chat entry (two Alexes, no amount) by asking and never guessing. Locked recipient/amount to transfer ID. Addressed chat disconnect and late resolution. For incident, proposed pausing sends, reconciling pending transfers, and escalating with clear ownership.

dimensions.name: shipping product
dimensions.evidence: Scoped two-week MVP to one path with pending row, status lookup, four result states. Identified sign-offs (tech lead for API, product for states). Incident response: pause sends, keep reads, reconcile, escalate with count and plan. Showed awareness of rollout risk and rollback.

strongest: current ability: solid mobile wallet design with idempotency, offline pending state, and failure handling; clear ownership and trade-off reasoning.
risks: Limited evidence of level 4 (counter-examples, tests, production metrics) across dimensions; some answers repeated points; incident escalation timing could be more precise.
